title: Machine Learning Basics
description:
# Introduction to Machine Learning

Learn the basics of machine learning using scikit-learn.

## Requirements
⚠️ **Important:** This assignment requires the "Machine Learning Environment" Docker image with scikit-learn installed.

## What You'll Learn
- Load datasets
- Train simple models
- Make predictions
- Evaluate model performance

**Prerequisites:** Basic Python, NumPy knowledge

questions.title: Load and Explore Data
questions.description:
Load the Iris dataset from sklearn.datasets and store it in a variable called `iris`. Print the shape of the data (number of samples and features).

**Expected output format:**

